June 12, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Beach Investment Counsel Inc increased its stake in Morgan Stanley (MS) by 40.1% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beach Investment Counsel Inc bought 70,430 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.02% with the market. The hedge fund held 246,060 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.28 million, up from 175,630 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beach Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Morgan Stanley for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $90.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.89% or $0.46 during the last trading session, reaching $51.32. About 8.95 million shares traded. Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) has risen 24.35% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 11.78% the S&P500. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp decreased its stake in Wynn Resorts Ltd (WYNN) by 8.78% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp sold 4,286 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.92% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 44,552 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.13M, down from 48,838 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp who had been investing in Wynn Resorts Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $19.48B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.79% or $1.43 during the last trading session, reaching $179.39. About 2.71 million shares traded or 7.12% up from the average.
